name: Govardhan

queries.query: Govardhan Uttar Pradesh official land records cadastral map GIS parcel viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council land-records portal, the live UP Bhunaksha cadastral map viewer, the UP cadastral-map digitization dashboard, and the official Mathura district tehsil page. The Mathura district page lists GOVERDHAN as a tehsil; the live viewer exposes the Mathura/Govardhan administrative path. No parcel geometry was available for the town village tested.

queries.query: गोवर्धन उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भूलेख नक्शा खसरा खतौनी
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery reached the same Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council land-records and cadastral-map services. The official dashboard lists Mathura/Govardhan villages whose cadastral maps are unavailable, including गोबर्धन गोरबा अ.टाउन (village code 124236).

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Uttar Pradesh Revenue Council / UP Bhulekh and Bhunaksha services, with Mathura District Administration and Goverdhan Tehsil as the local administrative custodian
registryEvidence.scope: Local tehsil and district land-record/cadastral-map service route. The official Mathura district page lists GOVERDHAN as a tehsil, and the UP Bhunaksha viewer identifies the Mathura district, Govardhan tehsil, and village-level cadastral map status.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a local registry/cadastral service and custodian, not open citywide parcel geometry access. General national land-record prose was not treated as local evidence.
